snippet.title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://atelier.games/resleriana_rw/uk/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=FirstLookPV1UK&utm_id=Caption

Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian is coming to PlayStation®5*, Nintendo Switch™ and Steam® on 26th September 2025.

*Please be advised that the PlayStation®4 version will not be sold outside of Japan.
